title: feat(spec): the Studio hook form offers texts, and HookContext declares ctx.text
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu19ctjaTjyM4gmWfgBPNRmc)_
Fixes #34575
Fixes #35197
Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — skills/objectstack-data/references/data-hooks.md already teaches ctx.text (ctx table row and the "Declared texts" section); this PR declares its type and adds the Studio row

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：在 Studio 里编辑钩子时，表单多了一行「文本」，可以直接填写钩子按组织语言写进记录的句子，十一种界面语言都有说明；用类型写钩子代码的开发者，调用取句子的方法不再报类型错误。
- 为什么做：钩子按组织语言写句子的能力上一版已上线，但界面里写不了、公开类型里也没有声明，应用只能自己补一份本地类型（钩子按组织语言写句子这条线的收尾）。
- 出错会怎样：最坏是这一行的说明或某种语言的译文措辞不准，或开发者看到的类型提示不对；钩子运行不受影响，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

**Studio hook form (#34575).** `hook.form.ts` gains a `texts` row in the Body section, beside `refusals`: `type: 'record'`, `widget: 'key-only-record'`, with entry fields `message` (textarea, required) and `params` (tags), the two keys of the served entry schema (`declaredTextEntrySchema('hook')`: `{ message, params? }`). The key-only face is generic (`KEY_ONLY_RECORD_WIDGET` in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/SchemaForm.tsx` keys off the row's `widget`, and reads the key rule from the served `propertyNames.pattern`), and `refusals` already exercises the same two entry controls, so no renderer change is needed. The `hook` / `texts` omit row is deleted from `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`; the `action` / `refusals` and `action` / `texts` rows stay (other cards). The eleven `metadata-forms` packs carry the row's label and help text: `en` regenerated by `node scripts/check-i18n-bundles.mjs --write`, the ten translated packs hand-written, following each pack's wording for the `refusals` row.

**`HookContext.text` (#35197).** `HookContextSchema` declares `text`, the way it declares `api` and `notice`: `z.unknown().optional()` at parse (JSON Schema `{}`), cast to the named function type `HookTextReader` for the type: `(key: string, params?)` resolving to a string, `params` a name-to-value record. The signature is the card's and matches what the runtime binds exactly (`HookTextSurface` in `packages/runtime/src/sandbox/hook-text.ts`: same params type, same return type). The runtime binds it on both hook paths: the sandboxed body (`buildSandboxContext`) and the in-process handler proxy in `body-runner.ts`. `HookContextSchema.parse` now keeps a bound `text` instead of stripping it. The generated `api-surface`, `export-origins`, `authorable-surface` and `references/data/hook.mdx` rows move by one line each.

Read first, by risk:
1. `packages/spec/src/data/hook.zod.ts`: the `text` member and `HookTextReader` (a published type, Clause-② widening).
2. `packages/spec/src/data/hook.form.ts`: the `texts` row.
3. One translated pack, e.g. `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/zh-CN.metadata-forms.generated.ts`, the three `texts` entries under `hook.fields`.

## Tests

- New `packages/spec/src/data/hook-context-text.test.ts`: the member's type equals the runtime surface in both directions and is optional; a typed handler calls it; three `@ts-expect-error` reverse checks (number key, positional params, numeric result), live because `tsconfig.test.json` compiles this file (`check:test-typecheck` OK); and the parse keeps a bound `text`.
- `metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` passes with the omit row gone.
- Three count pins in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations/` move with the new row: hook enumerated children 12 to 14 (two files), translated row labels 741 to 744.

<details><summary>Readings (head 3d0f92b1)</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test`: Test Files 856 passed, 1 skipped (857); Tests 27389 passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects test`: Test Files 123 passed (123); Tests 2050 passed (2050).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`, 240 ledgered errors held, none in the new file). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/platform-objects typecheck`: exit 0.
- Before the fix, on spec dist built from the base: `tsc` over `async (ctx: HookContext) => { await ctx.text('follow_up_subject', { lead }) }` answers `TS2339: Property 'text' does not exist`, strict and non-strict. After: non-strict exit 0; strict answers `TS2722` (see Acceptance notes); `await ctx.text?.(...)` compiles under strict, and a number key is a type error.
- Ablation (one, the parse behaviour): renaming the `text:` member via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (anchor 1 to 0, blob changed) reds `the parse keeps the bound function instead of stripping it` (Tests 1 failed, 3 passed); restore proven (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty).
- `pnpm check:i18n`: OK, all bundles in sync. `pnpm check:i18n-coverage`: OK, none new. `node scripts/check-cli-command-ids.mjs`: exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated`: all 14 artifacts up to date.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands`: 116 families; `--ran`: 115 run with exit 0, 1 NOT MEASURED (`check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`, exit 3, its positive-control commit is outside this shallow clone).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Strict mode.** The member is optional, as the card states and as `api` and `notice` are, because a context parsed without the runtime carries none. Under `strict`, the documented `await ctx.text('k')` therefore answers `TS2722` (possibly undefined) rather than `TS2339`; a strict handler has to narrow first. The narrowing spellings an author reaches for, `ctx.text?.('k')` (and in TS `ctx.text!('k')`), are not read by the save-time literal check, which matches only `ctx.text('k'`: measured on the built spec, a js body `await ctx.text?.('undeclared_key')` parses, while `await ctx.text('undeclared_key')` is refused at save. The key is still refused when the hook runs. Raised to the seat as an open question; not changed here.
- Clause-② reading for the metadata-forms keys: `@objectstack/platform-objects` publishes the packs as `MetadataFormsTranslations: TranslationBundle` (`dist/metadata-translations/index.d.ts`); no declaration names a pack key (the existing `refusals.params` key, as control, is in no `.d.ts` either). The new keys are published runtime content, not a published type.
- The claim said `Metadata-protocol: none`; the authorable-surface ratchet records `HookContext` members (it gains `data/HookContext:text`), so the kind is `added`, and `@objectstack/spec` takes `minor` (correction of the dispatch, measured by the Check Changeset gate). Nothing a stack writes changes: `texts` was already authorable. No ADR-0087 entry.

## Verification

Two minutes: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/data/hook-context-text.test.ts src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts`. Expected: both files pass, and `git grep -n "key: 'texts'" packages/spec/src/system/metadata-form-zod-reconciliation.test.ts` lists only the `action` row.
